title: Opus 5 AI matches top models at half the cost with unique self-coding #AI #Tech #Innovation
description:
Opus 5 is an emerging AI model that balances performance and cost efficiency, positioning itself as a strong alternative to Claude's Fable 5. While Fable 5 retains a slight edge in intelligence, Opus 5 achieves nearly comparable results—within half a percent on a challenging coding benchmark—at roughly half the cost, making it a compelling value proposition for users. What sets Opus 5 apart is its demonstrated ability to innovate autonomously: when tasked with reconstructing a 3D model of a machine part from an image it couldn’t directly “see,” Opus 5 independently developed computer vision code to extract the shape from raw pixels. This breakthrough highlights a shift in AI capability from merely using predefined tools to actively creating them, signaling a new era of adaptable, self-sufficient AI. This evolution reshapes the AI pricing structure, offering professional-grade intelligence at significantly lower price points. As a result, users previously paying premium rates for access to advanced AI models can now achieve similar outcomes more affordably, driving broader accessibility and efficiency in applications that rely on AI-driven problem solving and creativity. #Opus5 #AIModel #ClaudeFable5
